items.title: Jay Leonhart interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 27, 2013 [interview 2 of 2]…
items.q: I’ve done concerts of just myself... at the top and the bottom of Bach

ctx.x: And just the vocal note, with your bass line, those two things moving, great stuff.

Yeah. I enjoy it. You know if you can get it to sound decent you can have a lot of fun with just being at the top and the bottom of Bach, leaving the middle two lines to someone else, you know you’re the lead and the bass. And I mean I’ve done concerts of just myself, and it’s great fun. And I’ve not gotten a bad review from it, because you’ve got to do awfully interesting material however. You’ve got to find ways to make it very interesting for the audience because you’re going to walk out there with a bass, so…
Excellent. These jazz parties — when was the first time you did a jazz party?
